context:
Mirror the ClickHouse pattern from the just-completed
clickhouse-error-message-capture TODO. For each except site:
  1. Replace bare `except Exception` with the most specific exception class
     the underlying SDK raises (boto3, firebolt-sdk, pynvml, etc.).
  2. Always write str(exception) to the result's error field before re-raising
     or returning a failure result.
  3. Add a structured log line (logger.warning) so failures are visible in
     both the result JSON and the run log.
Add one unit test per file that injects a synthetic exception via mock and
asserts the error message round-trips to the result.

For the experimental GPU modules, keep tests hermetic: use monkeypatch/fakes
so CI does not require CUDA, NVML, or a real GPU.
description:
Quality plan Phase 1c. The just-completed clickhouse-error-message-capture
TODO (Pattern G from the SF1 failure analysis) ensures str(exception) lands
in the result error field. The audit found 10 bare `except Exception:` sites
that swallow error messages the same way:
  - benchbox/platforms/redshift.py (3)
  - benchbox/platforms/firebolt.py (1)
  - benchbox/experimental/gpu/metrics.py (3)
  - benchbox/experimental/gpu/capabilities.py (1)
  - benchbox/experimental/concurrency/pool_tester.py (2)

These distort benchmark results when failures occur silently. Apply the same
error-capture pattern uniformly.
